title: Control Loops: Sensors, Recipe Bounds and Commands
description: Per quantity of a zone: each sensor, the value the loop's rule used, the bounds of the recipe step running, and the command sent (UP, DOWN, OFF) with what it does.

options.content:
**How to read this report.** One block per quantity of the selected unit and zone, for the runs in the time range.

1. **Sensors**: a zone may have more than one sensor for a quantity (the SHT45 and the SCD30 both measure air temperature and humidity). Each is drawn on its own (thin lines, *zone / sensor*).
2. **Rule**: the loop's rule decides which reading it uses: *reference* (one sensor, with a fallback when it goes stale), or the average, lowest or highest of the fresh sensors. Readings older than the loop's limit are ignored. The value it used is the **thick white line**.
3. **Recipe bounds**: the recipe step running at that moment sets a lower and an upper bound (dashed blue and red, the band between them shaded). They change at every step.
4. **Command**: from the value used and the bounds, the run's control algorithm decides **UP**, **DOWN** or **OFF**; the bar under the chart shows what was sent and what it does. For CO₂ the command drives the fresh-air fan, so **UP lowers CO₂**. *(held)* means no fresh reading: the last command is kept.

The table on top of each block is the latest state; *Within the bounds* is the share of the loop's decisions in the time range whose value was inside the recipe's bounds.

panels.title: Light (the recipe step's light, on and off)
panels.description: What the run sent to the zone's lights: ON with the light type of the recipe step (RED, BLUE, WHITE, DARK…), or OFF.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.measure_timestamp AS time,
       CASE x.command WHEN 'ON' THEN 'ON: ' || COALESCE(x.msg->>'value', '') ELSE 'OFF' END AS "Light"
  FROM medcea.v_ct_measurements x
 WHERE $__timeFilter(x.measure_timestamp) AND x.unit_code = '$unit' AND x.zone_code = '$zone' AND x.tag = 'light'
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ${quantity:text}: the loop now
panels.description: The latest decision of this quantity's loop in the zone: its rule and the sensors it may use (from the run's recorded loop map), the bounds of the recipe step now running, the value it used, whether that is inside the bounds, and the command it sent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN l.l IS NULL THEN 'no run of $unit in the time range' ELSE
    CASE l.l->'input'->>'rule'
      WHEN 'reference' THEN 'Uses ' || (l.l->'input'->>'reference')
           || COALESCE('; falls back to ' || (l.l->'input'->>'fallback') || ' when it is stale', '; holds the last command when it is stale')
      WHEN 'mean' THEN 'Average of the fresh sensors'
      WHEN 'min'  THEN 'Lowest of the fresh sensors'
      WHEN 'max'  THEN 'Highest of the fresh sensors'
      WHEN 'single' THEN 'The one fresh sensor (two fresh ones: no decision, alarm)'
      ELSE COALESCE(l.l->'input'->>'rule', 'default map') END
    || COALESCE(' · readings older than ' || (l.l->'input'->>'max_age_s') || ' s are ignored', '') END AS "Rule",
  CASE jsonb_typeof(l.l->'input'->'sources') WHEN 'array'
       THEN (SELECT string_agg(s, ', ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(l.l->'input'->'sources') s)
       ELSE l.l->'input'->>'sources' END AS "Sensors it may use",
  (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'lower') || ' – ' || (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'upper')
     || CASE '${quantity:raw}' WHEN 'co2' THEN ' ppm' WHEN 'air_humidity' THEN ' %RH' ELSE ' °C' END AS "Recipe bounds now",
  'step ' || k.step || ', cycle ' || k.cyc || ' of run ' || k.recipe_run_id AS "Recipe step",
  (c.msg->>'process_value')::numeric AS "Value used",
  CASE WHEN (c.msg->>'process_value') IS NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN (c.msg->>'process_value')::numeric < (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'lower')::numeric THEN 'below the bounds'
       WHEN (c.msg->>'process_value')::numeric > (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'upper')::numeric THEN 'above the bounds'
       ELSE 'within the bounds' END AS "Value vs bounds",
  (SELECT CASE '${quantity:raw}'
    WHEN 'co2' THEN CASE x.command WHEN 'UP' THEN 'UP: fresh-air fan on (lowers CO₂)' WHEN 'OFF' THEN 'OFF: fan off (CO₂ rises)' ELSE x.command END
    WHEN 'air_humidity' THEN CASE x.command WHEN 'UP' THEN 'UP: humidifier on (raises humidity)' WHEN 'DOWN' THEN 'DOWN: dry the air (lowers humidity)' WHEN 'OFF' THEN 'OFF: nothing on' ELSE x.command END
    ELSE CASE x.command WHEN 'UP' THEN 'UP: heating on' WHEN 'DOWN' THEN 'DOWN: cooling on' WHEN 'OFF' THEN 'OFF: nothing on' ELSE x.command END
  END FROM (SELECT c.command) x) AS "Last command",
  c.msg->>'state' AS "Loop state",
  c.measure_timestamp AS "At"
FROM (SELECT 1) one
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start AS t0,
               COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) AS t1,
               c.recipe_run_id, c.recipe_item_seq_id AS step, c.recipe_item_seq_cycle_num AS cyc,
               (CASE WHEN json_typeof(c.run_params) = 'array' THEN c.run_params->0 END) AS p
          FROM medcea.recipe_line_cycle_run c
          JOIN medcea.recipe_run r ON r.recipe_run_id = c.recipe_run_id
          JOIN medcea.cea_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id
         WHERE u.unit_code = '$unit'
           AND c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start < $__timeTo()
           AND COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) > $__timeFrom()) k0 ORDER BY k0.t0 DESC LIMIT 1) k ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e AS l FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE jsonb_typeof(k.p::jsonb->'control_loops') WHEN 'array' THEN k.p::jsonb->'control_loops' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) e
                    WHERE e->>'loop_code' = '${quantity:raw}' AND e->>'zone_code' = '$zone') l ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.measure_timestamp, x.command, x.msg FROM medcea.v_ct_measurements x
                    WHERE $__timeFilter(x.measure_timestamp) AND x.unit_code = '$unit' AND x.zone_code = '$zone'
                      AND x.msg->>'loop' = '${quantity:raw}' ORDER BY x.measure_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true

panels.title: Within the bounds
panels.description: Share of the loop's decisions in the time range whose value was inside the recipe step's bounds at that moment.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN v.x BETWEEN (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'lower')::numeric
                                       AND (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'upper')::numeric THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Within the bounds"
  FROM (SELECT x.measure_timestamp AS t, (x.msg->>'process_value')::numeric AS x
          FROM medcea.v_ct_measurements x
         WHERE $__timeFilter(x.measure_timestamp) AND x.unit_code = '$unit' AND x.zone_code = '$zone'
           AND x.msg->>'loop' = '${quantity:raw}' AND x.msg->>'process_value' IS NOT NULL) v
  JOIN (SELECT c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start AS t0,
               COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) AS t1,
               c.recipe_run_id, c.recipe_item_seq_id AS step, c.recipe_item_seq_cycle_num AS cyc,
               (CASE WHEN json_typeof(c.run_params) = 'array' THEN c.run_params->0 END) AS p
          FROM medcea.recipe_line_cycle_run c
          JOIN medcea.recipe_run r ON r.recipe_run_id = c.recipe_run_id
          JOIN medcea.cea_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id
         WHERE u.unit_code = '$unit'
           AND c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start < $__timeTo()
           AND COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) > $__timeFrom()) k ON v.t >= k.t0 AND v.t < k.t1

panels.title: ${quantity:text}: each sensor, the value the loop used, and the recipe's bounds
panels.description: Thin lines: every sensor of this quantity in the zone (zone / sensor). Thick white line: the value the loop used after its rule. Dashed lines: the recipe step's lower (blue) and upper (red) bound while a run's step was active; no band where no run was running.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(measure_timestamp, $__interval), concat_ws(' / ', zone_code, sensor) AS metric, avg(value) AS value
  FROM medcea.v_ap_measurements
 WHERE $__timeFilter(measure_timestamp) AND unit_code = '$unit' AND zone_code = '$zone'
   AND tag = CASE '${quantity:raw}' WHEN 'substrate_temperature' THEN 'ground_temperature' ELSE '${quantity:raw}' END
 GROUP BY 1, zone_code, sensor
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(x.measure_timestamp, $__interval), 'Value the loop used' AS metric,
       avg((x.msg->>'process_value')::numeric) AS value
  FROM medcea.v_ct_measurements x
 WHERE $__timeFilter(x.measure_timestamp) AND x.unit_code = '$unit' AND x.zone_code = '$zone'
   AND x.msg->>'loop' = '${quantity:raw}' AND x.msg->>'process_value' IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT b.time, b.lower AS "Recipe lower bound", b.upper AS "Recipe upper bound"
  FROM (SELECT k.t0 AS time, (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'lower')::numeric AS lower,
               (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'upper')::numeric AS upper FROM (SELECT c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start AS t0,
               COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) AS t1,
               c.recipe_run_id, c.recipe_item_seq_id AS step, c.recipe_item_seq_cycle_num AS cyc,
               (CASE WHEN json_typeof(c.run_params) = 'array' THEN c.run_params->0 END) AS p
          FROM medcea.recipe_line_cycle_run c
          JOIN medcea.recipe_run r ON r.recipe_run_id = c.recipe_run_id
          JOIN medcea.cea_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id
         WHERE u.unit_code = '$unit'
           AND c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start < $__timeTo()
           AND COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) > $__timeFrom()) k
        UNION ALL
        SELECT k.t1, (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'lower')::numeric,
               (k.p->'setpoints'->'${quantity:raw}'->>'upper')::numeric FROM (SELECT c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start AS t0,
               COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) AS t1,
               c.recipe_run_id, c.recipe_item_seq_id AS step, c.recipe_item_seq_cycle_num AS cyc,
               (CASE WHEN json_typeof(c.run_params) = 'array' THEN c.run_params->0 END) AS p
          FROM medcea.recipe_line_cycle_run c
          JOIN medcea.recipe_run r ON r.recipe_run_id = c.recipe_run_id
          JOIN medcea.cea_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id
         WHERE u.unit_code = '$unit'
           AND c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start < $__timeTo()
           AND COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) > $__timeFrom()) k
        UNION ALL
        SELECT k.t1 + interval '1 second', NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start AS t0,
               COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) AS t1,
               c.recipe_run_id, c.recipe_item_seq_id AS step, c.recipe_item_seq_cycle_num AS cyc,
               (CASE WHEN json_typeof(c.run_params) = 'array' THEN c.run_params->0 END) AS p
          FROM medcea.recipe_line_cycle_run c
          JOIN medcea.recipe_run r ON r.recipe_run_id = c.recipe_run_id
          JOIN medcea.cea_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id
         WHERE u.unit_code = '$unit'
           AND c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start < $__timeTo()
           AND COALESCE(c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end, now()) > $__timeFrom()) k
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM medcea.recipe_line_cycle_run n
                            WHERE n.recipe_run_id = k.recipe_run_id
                              AND n.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start BETWEEN k.t1 - interval '5 seconds' AND k.t1 + interval '60 seconds'
                              AND (n.recipe_item_seq_id, n.recipe_item_seq_cycle_num) <> (k.step, k.cyc))) b
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ${quantity:text}: command sent, and what it does
panels.description: Every command the loop sent to the zone's actuator, after the quantity's command map. For CO₂ the actuator is the fresh-air fan: UP lowers CO₂. (held) means no fresh reading, so the last command was kept.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.measure_timestamp AS time,
       CASE '${quantity:raw}'
    WHEN 'co2' THEN CASE x.command WHEN 'UP' THEN 'UP: fresh-air fan on (lowers CO₂)' WHEN 'OFF' THEN 'OFF: fan off (CO₂ rises)' ELSE x.command END
    WHEN 'air_humidity' THEN CASE x.command WHEN 'UP' THEN 'UP: humidifier on (raises humidity)' WHEN 'DOWN' THEN 'DOWN: dry the air (lowers humidity)' WHEN 'OFF' THEN 'OFF: nothing on' ELSE x.command END
    ELSE CASE x.command WHEN 'UP' THEN 'UP: heating on' WHEN 'DOWN' THEN 'DOWN: cooling on' WHEN 'OFF' THEN 'OFF: nothing on' ELSE x.command END
  END || CASE WHEN x.msg->>'state' = 'hold' THEN ' (held: no fresh reading)' ELSE '' END AS "Command sent"
  FROM medcea.v_ct_measurements x
 WHERE $__timeFilter(x.measure_timestamp) AND x.unit_code = '$unit' AND x.zone_code = '$zone'
   AND x.msg->>'loop' = '${quantity:raw}'
 ORDER BY 1
